periods.time: Morning at the Guild before Denatus
periods.label: Eina receives Bell's level-up report

status.work_state: Busy handling anxious adventurers after reports of a Minotaur in the upper floors.

appearance.overview: Composed half-elf receptionist with green eyes and a gentle smile.
distinctive: beautiful smile that freezes when shocked

personality.summary: Professional and deeply protective toward Bell; relief at his safety turns into disbelief at his record-fast level-up.
flaws: can overreact when Bell defies common expectations
personality.inner_conflict: She must balance Bell's growth with his safety.

decision_pattern.advisor_mode: Warns, verifies, then gives conditional approval only with safeguards.

habits.daily_routine: Receives and advises adventurers at Guild headquarters.
quirks: thinks of Bell with younger-brother-like concern

background.pre_story: Serves as Bell's Guild advisor and knows he was nearly killed by a Minotaur.

relationships.bell-cranel: Advised adventurer whose rapid growth worries and amazes her.

knowledge: Knows Minotaurs normally appear from the middle floors
Knows Bell reached Lv.2 in about one and a half months
periods.summary: Eina worries over Bell's Minotaur context, apologizes for exposing his level-up, advises him on safety and development ability, and later sets strict conditions before approving his party for the middle floors.

key_events.summary: Eina hears Bell's Lv.2 report and shouts at his unprecedented growth speed.
Eina frames Bell's choice between Hunter and Luck around his long-term goal.

periods.time: One week after Ushiwakamaru is forged
periods.label: Eina conditionally approves middle-floor entry

status.advisor_action: Approves Bell's party for middle floors only if every member equips Salamander Wool.

appearance.overview: Serious Guild advisor in a private interview room.
distinctive: forceful warning posture when safety is at stake

personality.summary: Careful and protective; she recognizes Bell's readiness but turns approval into a safety checklist.
fears: Bell entering the middle floors underprepared
desires: Bell's party should equip proper safeguards
personality.inner_conflict: Bell is ready by numbers, but his party remains unusual and fragile.

decision_pattern.approval: Uses status benchmarks, party composition, and required equipment before approving entry.

quote_samples: 在装备这个之前绝对不可以踏进中层！

mannerisms: leans forward and raises a finger when warning Bell

education.guild_floor_guidance: Knows floor ability benchmarks and protective gear requirements

background.pre_story: Has repeatedly warned Bell not to take reckless risks.

relationships.bell-cranel: Adventurer she conditionally approves for the middle floors.
relationships.welf-crozzo: New party member whose Crozzo name surprises her.

knowledge: Knows the Crozzo name is famous among adventurers
Knows Bell's current Lv.2 status values
Knows 13th-14th floor benchmarks are around I-H
periods.summary: Eina hears about Welf Crozzo, checks Bell's unusually fast-growing Lv.2 status, decides the three-person party can barely challenge the middle floors, and gives Bell Salamander Wool coupons as a mandatory condition.

key_events.summary: Eina approves middle-floor entry only after requiring Salamander Wool for all party members.
